notes.title: Patch v1.1.10
notes.notes:
Patch v1.1.10 Notes - Small modifications target mostly to improve game performance.

Bug & Fixes
* Achievements panel. Bug that was affecting proper presentation of a damage and kills progress.
* Code and colliders modification made in order to fix FPS drops on Steam Deck, especially on a map 3 & 4.

PickUps;
* Add for a buff pickups, small scale animation to make them more visible on the map:

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.1.8
notes.notes:
Patch v1.1.8

Bug & Fixes
* It was not really a bug. However price "increase factor" in Hangar has been removed. No more mathematical riddles in Hangar.
* Deep code refactoring to increase game performance.

Weapons Changes for Default Values;
* Double Gun: Increased default projectiles number.

UI Improvement
* There is a new window in Main Menu - "Achievements". It will describe and track status for all the achievements in a game.

notes.title: Update notes for patch v1.1.5
notes.notes:
Bug & Fixes:
* Boss Enemy will not rotate during pause anymore.
* Correct few spelling mistakes.
* Buffs Depo Circle will deactivate with delay, allowing to pick up all buffs first.

Weapons Changes for Default Values:
* Triple barrel: reload time changed from 3s to 4s.
* Double Gun: reload time changed from 3.5s to 4s.
* Normal Rockets: Damage 5->4 ; Reload 4s -> 4.5s
* Yellow Sondas: Reload 4.25s -> 4.5s
* Red Sondas: Reload 4.25s -> 4.5s
* Yellow, Blue, Red Lasers: Reload 4.25s -> 4.5s

* Yellow, Blue, Red Guns: Projectiles Numbers 4 -> 5
* Piercing Arrow: Damage 4->5 ; Arrow number 2->3
* Burning Blades: Damage 4->5 ; Jumps Number 1->2 ; Penetration 1->2
* Freezing Blades: Damage 4->5 ; Jumps Number 1->2 ; Penetration 1->2
* Gravity Field: Explosions Number 1->2
* Electric Discharge: Damage 4->6 ; Projectiles Number 2->3
* Space Mines: Change in Level-Up tree, additional launcher on level 4 and 7 in stead of 5 and 8.
* Yellow & Red Sondas : Change in Level-Up tree, additional launcher on level 4 and 7 in stead of 5 and 8.
* Plasma Torch : Change in Level-Up tree, additional launcher on 7 in stead of 8.

* AI for main weapon: increases search speed and reduced search radius in order to make it more reactive towards closer enemies.

Enemy Changes:
* Increased rotation speed for Boss space ship by 50%
* Increased rotation speed for Boss Turrets by 25%.

UI Improvement:
* Gears counter is showing now a mission gears_target as well.
* Added Black Outline around Buff Timer to make it more visible.
* Hot-Key for switching between Auto and Manual Aiming for a main weapon. 
	Now, during a mission, you can use "Q" on keyboard or "X" on a Gamepad to switch between Aiming options for main Turret.
	Note: this is only working during the mission, when Pause Window is closed.
	
* Increased size for a crosshair.
* Re-Roll System: Three fist Re-Rolls are free from now on. Plus re-roll will always show a new items, when it is possible.
* Additional Toggle option to switch On/Off level indicators for equipment (weapons and power-ups).

notes.title: Nebula Patch v1.1.4
notes.notes:
Patch notes for v1.1.4

This will be a quick update for Nebula to rectify most urgent bugs and add a bit more functionality to the game.

[olist]
 Fix for a bug related to YYBurningBall Achievement - Regular plasma ball was not triggering this achievement and I have fixed it in this patch.
 Several spelling mistakes corrected.
 Additional Input for player movement on Keyboard - Now it will be possible to move space ship with IJKL buttons as well.
 Additional Resolution in Graphic Options - 3840 x 2160 (4k)
 Changes to Auto-Aim system were also implemented. Now all automated turrets will look for enemies in a closer proximity to main ship.
[/olist]

Those are all changes for the moment, hope you enjoy the game despite small bugs 🙂 
By the way if you want to discuss other topics and share ideas with developer, here is a link to a Discord server:

Discord Server - JuTek Pixel

Best Regards.
Dev.

notes.title: Nebula Demo Patch v0.7.4
notes.notes:
Patch notes for v0.7.4

There are few improvement that I've managed to implement quite fast.

Bug Fixes
[olist]
  It was reported couple of times, that max weapon level did repeat in Level-up window so I've prepared additional safety checks in a code to try to prevent it.
  Enemies will spawn rotated towards player from the start.
[/olist]

Improvements
[olist]
  Add toggle button in "Options" to turn ON/OFF camera shake when mass bomb is picked up.   
  Another toggle button in "Options" to allow to turn ON/OFF an Auto-Aim AI for a main turret. This I made for a players that maybe for some reason cannot (or maybe simply do not want to) play with both hands. With this option ON,  game will be playable with just keyboard or left stick on game controller.
[/olist]

Best Regards.
Dev.

notes.title: Nebula Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello Nebula Saviours

I have prepared couple of bug fixes and improvements for Nebula Demo version.

Bug Fixes
[olist]
  I've improved logic behind Leveling System so hopefully freezing bug on several level-ups will be solved with this.
  Double click bug on Level-up window should be fixed now as well.
  I made a few modifications to UI manager and this should also fix an issue with an endless game after win screen.
[/olist]

Improvements
[olist]
  Increase by 25% rotation speed for a main weapon on start. I would like to keep some small delay on this weapon to keep a feeling that it is still a turret. Besides there are some means in a game to increase rotation speed of weapon with Hangar Improvements, PowerUps or Leveling-Up weapons.   
  You will notice some visual changes for Enemy bullets.
  Two new sound tracks added.
[/olist]

There are bunch of items locked as you noticed and in a Demo there is no possibility to unlock it. It will be available and unlock-able in a full version of a game.

Thank you for all your comments and remarks. There are quite many new ideas from players, I will go  through all of them see what I can do. Release date is quite close and I am focusing now to prepare all files for relaease therefore potential further improvements will be implemented in a full version directly.

Cheers
Dev.
